residuals: 360 hot bands 6500-7500 and footer crop 4.16%: capture-timing artefact, not geometry. Anchors match live section-for-section at rest (Δ0 every section, doc 8812 both). The mood-calendar (and taste-profile) auto-cycle every 3s — a behaviour that fires on live — is scheduled by an IntersectionObserver AFTER stitch-shot clears timers; gate.sh settles only the live side, so on the build the cycle advances mid-capture (Bolder -> Balanced, whose note wraps one more line at 360) and every chunk from y=6300 down is stitched 24px low. Verified by an independent build capture (same result) and a scroll probe showing the mood section 910 -> 934px after ~3s on BOTH live and build. Not fixable in block code without removing a live behaviour; a build-side --settle (or freezing the cycle on both sides) would clear it.
